MSMER (2025-26) UG - MSMER (2024-25) Mission and Vision The Aim of the National Medical Commission is to provide for a Medical Education System- (i) that improves access to quality and affordable medical education (ii) that ensures availability of adequate and high quality medical professionals in all parts of the country; that promotes equitable and universal healthcare that encourages community health perspective Read More » The National Medical Commission (NMC), established under the NMC Act, 2019, is firmly committedto establishing a transparent, Progressive, and efficient regulatory framework for medical education and medical practice in the country.
